definitions.explanation: A yellow chemical element with a distinctive smell, commonly found near volcanoes and hot springs. Used in various industrial processes and associated with volcanic and geothermal areas in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{硫黄|いおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The smell of sulfur got stronger near the hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{硫黄|いおう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地表|ちひょう}→地表：18419_chihyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{結晶|けっしょう}→結晶：13798_kesshou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In volcanic regions, sulfur sometimes appears on the surface as yellow crystals.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the context of ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot springs) and ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧ (volcanoes). The distinctive rotten-egg smell of {硫黄|いおう} is a familiar sensory experience at many Japanese hot spring resorts.

WRITING:
{硫|りゅう} refers to sulfur as a chemical element and {黄|おう} means "yellow," describing the element's characteristic color. The reading いおう is irregular.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {硫黄|いおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧: smell of sulfur
- {硫黄|いおう}{泉|せん}: sulfur spring
- {硫黄|いおう}{島|じま}: Iwo Jima (literally "Sulfur Island")
